newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends down ahead of PORLA data.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends down ahead of PORLA data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Jan (3rd pos) 1,187 rgt/tonne Nov (south) 1,190 *
Open/hi/low 1,195/1,200/1,187 Prev close 1,185
Prev settlement 1,190 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended slightly lower on profit-taking ahead of release of PORLA crop report on Friday. Uncertainty over outcome of Pakistan's tender also dampened late sentiment. Resistance for third position remains at 1,200.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Prices also fell from the day's highs. Trading remained thin and focused on crude palm oil.
The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan has tendered for 4,500 tonnes of RBD palm oil and 2,000 tonnes of palm olein for shipment by December 10.
Further gains in Chicago soybean futures overnight had supported early prices.
A crop report from Malaysian private crop forecaster Ivan Wong released on Thursday did not provide fresh leads as Wong has maintained his earlier estimates.
He put Malaysia's palm oil output in October at 880,000 tonnes, up 1.8 percent over September, and end-October stocks at 965,000 tonnes.

January crude palm oil futures ended down three ringgit at 1,187 ringgit ($469.91) a tonne after hitting an early high of 1,200. Traders said resistance for the third position contract remained at 1,200 ringgit.
Volume on the futures market was 2,116 lots against 1,975 lots on Wednesday.
Physicals prices also fell from the day's highs at the close. Trading remained thin and focused on crude palm oil.
Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,190 ringgit ($471.10) a tonne with bids at 1,185, after trading from 1,195 to 1,190.
Nov (central) was offered at 1,180 with bids at 1,172.50, and traded from 1,180 to 1,172.50.
Nov (north) saw offers at 1,170 and bids at 1,165.
Dec (south) was offered at 1,205 ringgit with bids at 1,200. It was traded from 1,210 to 1,200.
Dec (central) saw offers at 1,195 and bids at 1,185.
Among refined products, Dec palm olein was offered at $542.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Jan/Feb/Mar also at $542.50.
Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $505, and Jan/Feb/Mar at $507.50.
Nov RBD palm stearin saw sellers at $370, Dec at $375 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $380.
Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $305.
